thread:
liz: Kicking off async check for Veridian private rollout. They go air-gapped tomorrow EOD PST. Need final egress/ingress checklist and owner for DC firewall rules.

omar: Runbook updated -> https://docs.internal/redwood/veridian-runbook (section: airgap). NAT/proxy question: do we allow 3 telemetry CIDRs or do we funnel via proxy?

kevin: @omar yes — agreed on funneling via proxy for audit, but we'll allow these CIDRs for direct telemetry as emergency fallback: 34.120.0.0/14, 52.41.128.0/18, 130.211.0.0/22. Confirm with security before cutover.

maria: Those CIDRs look OK but Veridian's InfoSec insists on explicit ports. Need TCP 443 outbound, TCP 22 only for ops bastion, and block all other outbound. Also require source IP whitelisting for management.

liz: Ops bastion creds are owned by @anita — Anita can you confirm day-zero key handoff and HSM/KMS access for the customer?

anita: Shared the temp bastion key in LastPass (folder: veridian/oncall). HSM integration is pending — sec ticket #7891 for KMS cert renewal. ETA for cert fix: 10pm PST tonight. Will update here when rotated.

sre-oncall: Noted. Can we also set a temporary fallback route to region-us-west2 (dedicated capacity) if NAT/proxy or egress fails? That way customer traffic remains live.

kevin: I'll add the fallback route and a healthcheck probe. Smoke probe command for cutover team: ```curl -I --resolve veridian.redwood.internal:443:10.2.1.5 https://veridian.redwood.internal/health``` — expect 200 within 2s.

maria: Also remember SNI mapping for the edge proxy. I just checked certs and the SAN for `veridian.redwood.private` is missing in the current cert bundle in the certs vault.

anita: Uploading cert bundle now... done. @liz can you confirm `veridian.redwood.private` shows up in cert list?

liz: I can see it now under certs/v2/veridian. Thanks.

liz: Quick ask — who owns the airgap image sync and post-transfer verification? tagging build-bot.

build-bot: Image sync job scheduled: `imagesync/veridian/airgap:latest` -> targets: 10.2.1.0/24. Start: 2026-03-17T02:15Z. 12 images queued, parallelism=4.

omar: I'll monitor the transfer logs. After transfer, validate checksums: `sha256sum *.tar.gz` and compare to values in the runbook.

kevin: If any image fails checksum, fallback is to pull quantized runtime v1.2.3 from internal registry and rebuild container on-host. FYI this is slightly higher latency but keeps services up.

sre-oncall: Post-cutover smoke checklist: run the curl health probe, then `tail -n 200 /var/log/redwood/runtime.log | grep ERROR`. Also verify KV cache warm-up within 5 minutes.

liz: Thanks. Last piece: who will own the 2-hour post-cutover watch window? Can @kevin take 14:00-16:00 PST?

kevin: I can take 14:00-16:00 PST. Will post a short runbook for on-call.

maria: I'll be on-network standby for firewall tweaks during that window.

anita: Ops will rotate keys at 23:30 PST tonight after KMS cert rotation, standing by for any issues.

liz: Perfect. If anything blocks the image sync or cert rotation, ping this thread and @sre-oncall. Thanks all :thumbsup:
